# LiveKit client

`livekit-client-a2ef1bed.tgz` is an unmodified build of [LiveKit commit a2ef1bed](https://github.com/livekit/client-sdk-js/commit/a2ef1bed38c7f0589cf7d228762a3fcda970405b), including [the signal shutdown fix](https://github.com/livekit/client-sdk-js/pull/2192).

Built with pnpm 10.34.5 using `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, `pnpm build`, and `pnpm pack`. The archive includes upstream licenses. Replace this dependency with an npm release once it includes the fix.

SHA-256: `5c4f1a5bc436d0b195f2964e64e2911298f653f061874bfe551f7ae02140aeb6`.
